names.note: Name page 13757 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Николай (Пономарев), диакон, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Николая диакона». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the corpus holds `ardalion-ponomarev` and `stephen-ponomarev`, two other forenames on other days, and no Nicholas of the surname.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая диакона (1918).»

attestations.note: The day's tenth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «диакона» and name page 13757 «диакон», which agree, so `deacon` and the office `Deacon` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*ponomarev*` returns two other forenames and the Cyrillic grep for «Пономарев» the same two. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
